title: Mixed Event — Take the Best Shot! — Episode1 To Give Her That Chocolate

meta.Episode: Episode1 — To Give Her That Chocolate
meta.Event Outline: For Valentine's Day, Kohane hopes to buy An the chocolates she wants to try, but unfortunately, they're all sold out. Then, she learns that those chocolates are one of the prizes for a Valentine's Day photo contest being held by a makeup brand!

rows.Line: Lunch break
Miyamasuzaka Girls Academy - Class 2-A

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: *Sigh*

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (I'm finishing my English review sooner than expected. I'll quickly memorize the rest of the vocab.)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (Oh, this word can be used in a lot of different ways... But how specifically? I think I'll try finding some examples...)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (An ad for chocolates...)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (That's right. Valentine's Day is coming up...)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (We've been so busy that it completely slipped my mind... But I'd still like to give chocolates to everyone. Plus, having something sweet might be a nice break from practice.)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Oh, Shiho would really love this chocolate bunny. And Minori might like these chocolate flowers.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Wow... These chocolate bonbons look so fancy. They look so yummy too!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: What brand are these...? Couleur Chocolat...? Wait, I've heard that name before somewhere...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: *Gasp*

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Hey, Kohane, check out these chocolates in this article! Don't they look amazing?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Huh? These are made of chocolate?
I thought they were makeup palettes.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Because they are! This cosmetics brand and chocolate company decided to make some stuff together!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Oh, you're right...!
It says, “A collaborative effort between Couleur Chocolat and Colore Mi.”

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Oh, this lipstick's also made of chocolate. That's so cute.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: I know, right? I'm not usually into this kind of stuff, but I thought these were so cute.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: And the chocolate this company makes is known to be really good.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
I wanna try them even just once.
But they're so cute that I might want to put them on display somewhere instead.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: It's the chocolate company An was talking about...!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Does this mean they're still selling that chocolate makeup? I'll try checking their website...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: They're all sold out...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (I guess I shouldn't be surprised. Both brands are really famous, so I'm sure a lot of people wanted these...)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (Aww... If only I'd looked into it a little sooner...)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (But there's no use moping. I'll just have to find something else...)
After school

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (Alright, I need to do my best again at practice.)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (But we're not scheduled to meet for a bit, so I think I'll use this time to search up about the event we're performing in today.)

rows.Speaker: Student A
rows.Line: Huh? Is it just me, Ishii, or did you put on more makeup than usual today?

rows.Speaker: Student B
rows.Line: Shh! I don't want the teachers to find out!

rows.Speaker: Student B
rows.Line: I just went and retouched everything because I'm thinking about taking a picture of myself for this photo contest.

rows.Speaker: Student A
rows.Line: A photo contest?

rows.Speaker: Student B
rows.Line: Yeah! And the winners get an awesome prize!

rows.Speaker: Student B
rows.Line:
Check it out!
You can win these special chocolates made by Couleur Chocolat in collaboration with Colore Mi!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: What...?

rows.Speaker: Student A
rows.Line:
Wow, these are so pretty!
Hold on. This prize includes makeup by Colore Mi too?!

rows.Speaker: Student B
rows.Line:
Yeah!
This even comes with an assortment of these brands' other bestselling items!

rows.Speaker: Student A
rows.Line: Oh my gosh. Maybe I'll send in an entry too.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
(Did I hear them right...?
You can win that set of chocolate makeup...?)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (I-I need to search this up...!)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
(Oh, here it is...!
Wow, you really can win them and a bunch of makeup...)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (So, if I were to somehow win, I'd be able to give these to An...)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (I'll take a closer look at the rules after I get home...!)
A few hours later
Kohane's Room

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Okay, so the rules for this photo contest are...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: “Entrants are required to use cosmetic products by Colore Mi and send in their photos through the entry website listed here.”

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: “Entries will be ranked based on an online poll, and the highest ranked entries will receive a glamorous prize!”

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (So, I have to put on their makeup, take a photo of myself and send it in... I'm not so sure about this now...)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (I mean, I hardly ever put on any makeup. Also, as much as I like photography, photos of myself are a bit...)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: No...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: I don't own any makeup, but I can at least practice taking photos of myself...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
(Hmm... I can try using my DSLR...
But my phone might be better for taking a close-up photo of myself.)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Okay, I'll use my index and pinky fingers to hold it steady, and then use my thumb to press the shutter button...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
O-Oh no...
It's hard to keep my hand steady and press the button at the same time.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: My fingers are starting to cramp...!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (Oh... I got so caught up in trying to press the button that I forgot to look at the camera...)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (I'll keep my eyes on the lens next time and...)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (Now I look really tense...)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (Smile... Relax...)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
*Sob*
My smile's all crooked...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (B-But I have to keep trying! For An's sake...!)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (I know. The timer function might make things easier...!)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: *Sigh*

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (I've tried a lot of different poses and angles, but nothing's working...)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (And on top of forgetting to look at the camera, my smile ends up looking weird every time...)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Am I just not cut out for this...?
